bullets: Own 3 Spring Boot microservices in a License & Certificate Management System built on eGov's DIGIT platform: Verifiable Credentials, PDF generation, and a JSON Schema registry.
Built Kafka producers and consumers for event-driven inter-service communication; the certificate service consumes payment-completed events to drive application workflow state transitions.
Designed the Verifiable Credentials service with 2 pluggable credential adapters (walt.id, MOSIP), enabling standards-based credential issuance and verification.
Built a PDF service that stores JSON templates, renders them to HTML, and generates PDFs via headless Chromium at ~5 PDFs/sec, with per-identifier rate limiting to protect rendering capacity.
Built a schema registry service for managing the JSON Schemas used across services.
Containerized services with Docker; supported DevOps on Kubernetes deployments via kubectl and pod-log debugging, shipping through Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.
Built backend services (Node.js, Express, MySQL) for a multi-tenant SaaS ERP serving 45 tenants across 5 modules, including Attendance (AMS), HRMS, User Management (UMS), and PMS.
Implemented event-driven async workflows with BullMQ job queues and Node.js EventEmitter for event-based notifications, keeping heavy work off the request path.
Built multi-tenant file storage on AWS S3 with presigned-URL uploads and per-tenant bucket management.
Cached analytics dashboards in Redis, cutting response time on million-row queries from 10s+ to 1–2s.
Designed REST APIs secured with JWT and RBAC on a normalized relational schema that kept data consistent across modules.
Built async XML ingestion for a job aggregation platform processing 10M+ listings in under 15s per run, using a native C++ parser across Node.js worker threads.
Built job filtering and short-link tracking to capture user interaction data for analytics and fraud detection.
